# Local statement renderer dependencies

These browser distributions are served locally so the interactive demo works offline.

- Marked 18.0.14: https://github.com/markedjs/marked (MIT)
- DOMPurify 3.4.16: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0)
- KaTeX 0.18.9, including auto-render and fonts: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX (MIT)

Each package directory includes its upstream license. Files are copied unmodified from the corresponding npm package.
